name: erdcloud
description: Official Claude Code plugins for ERDCloud, the web-based ERD (Entity Relationship Diagram) modeling service.

plugins.name: erdcloud
plugins.description: Create and edit ERDCloud diagrams from Claude Code through the ERDCloud MCP server: ERD tables, columns, relations, domains and memos, plus sequence diagrams, flowcharts, UML class diagrams and free-form shapes, with modeling guidance built in.
